title: Coherent exact inverse of the finite coefficient comparison
statement: Let ℓ be a prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_ℓ, and T a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which ℓ is invertible. Let J be a coefficient comparison datum [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum] between the actual raw rational systems [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-rational-category, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Each J.family.Φ_E is exact for the given finite_shift. There are finite equivalences HT_E from the framework E-stage to the PBC E-stage whose forward functors equal J.family.Φ_E. Their inverses form a coherent exact stage-system morphism H [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces] from the PBC system back to the framework system, with H.Φ_E = HT_E.inverse. There is a compatible transformation ν from J.family followed by H to the identity framework family, with each ν_E invertible and each component ν_E,K equal, under these endpoint identifications, to HT_E.unitIso.inv.app K. This assertion contains no two-scheme functor, no descended exactness assertion, and no retract-completeness assertion.

proof.text: Transport finite-stage rational exactness along J.finite_functor E. Equality of the shift isomorphisms given by finite_shift_normalization identifies the mapTriangle functors, proving J.family.Φ E exact with its prescribed shift. For each finite coefficient field E, change the functor of J.stage E.rational along J.finite_functor E to obtain HT E with forward functor exactly J.family.Φ E. Use the adjunction-induced inverse shift. The finite shift normalization identifies it with the specified exact equivalence shift, so the inverse functors are additive and preserve distinguished triangles.

For E ≤ L define the inverse-family scalar comparison from S_L/E followed by HT E inverse to HT L inverse followed by P_L/E by full faithfulness of HT L. At K in the PBC E-stage its image is the inverse forward comparison j at HT E inverse K, then P_L/E applied to the counit at E and K, then the inverse counit at L and P_L/E K. This determines the map and its inverse uniquely. To check a tower E ≤ L ≤ M, apply the faithful forward functor at M. Substitute this formula, move the counit components past the scalar comparison by naturality, and cancel the adjacent counit inverse/counit factors. The remaining equation is J.family.coh. Repeated fields give its unit specialization. Thus these functors and comparisons form a stage-system morphism H.

Equip H at every E with the inverse exact shift of HT E. Apply the forward faithful functor to its scalar comparison shift square. The adjunction unit and counit commute with these shifts; cancel their factors, leaving J.scalar_shift. Hence H is CoherentExactMorphism. Set ν E to the inverse unit of HT E, regarded using the equality of its forward and inverse functors with the corresponding stages of J and H. For its mixed scalar square, apply the faithful forward functor and substitute the mate formula: the triangle identity cancels the counit, and the remaining square is naturality of the forward comparison. The inverse-unit components give IsIso of ν E. Identity extensions and the zero object satisfy the same equations; scalar transitions are never assumed faithful.

theorem sfCoefficientCoherentInverse
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [dT : Fact (∃ m : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞))]
    [iT : Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (J : FdCoefficientComparison l Ω T) :
    (∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, (J.family.Φ E).IsTriangulated) ∧
    ∃ HT : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω,
        GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E ≌ pbcStageCategory l Ω T E,
      (∀ E, (HT E).functor = J.family.Φ E) ∧
      ∃ H : StageSystem.CoherentExactMorphism
          (pbcScalarSystem l Ω T dT.out iT.out)
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω T),
        (∀ E, H.base.Φ E = (HT E).inverse) ∧
        ∃ ν : StageSystem.Morphism.Hom (J.family.comp H.base)
            (StageSystem.Morphism.id
              (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω T)),
          (∀ E, IsIso (ν.τ E)) ∧
          ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
            (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
            HEq ((ν.τ E).app K) ((HT E).unitIso.inv.app K)
